rules.label: Download for Mac buttons on the home page

meta.notes: Checked 2026-11-07 in headless Chromium with an iPhone UA at 390x844, logged out. The recipe applies to discord.com and every subdomain; the only page with anything to hide is the marketing home https://discord.com/. discord.com/app redirects to discord.com/login, which is just the login form (no banner, no pop-up, no promo), and /nitro, /quests and /download are marketing pages without these elements. LIVE counts on the home page: body:has(div.home--hero) matched once (the hero section is only on the home page) and the rule body:has(div.home--hero) a[href*="/api/downloads/distributions/"] matched 3 - the white Download for Mac hero button, the Download for Mac button at the bottom of the mobile menu and the Download for Mac button in the closing band; the same href pattern matches 18 links on /download, which is why the rule is scoped to the home page. div.discord_banner matched 1 (the 631px 'YOU CAN'T SCROLL ANYMORE, BETTER GO CHAT' band at the end of the page) and 0 on /download, /nitro, /quests and /login. Not verified: everything behind the login (the app UI, its pop-ups and Nitro or Quests promos), the cookie consent layer (the OneTrust container #onetrust-consent-sdk is present on the home page but the banner itself never rendered in this session, so no rule was shipped for it), and the /download page. No community filter list was consulted.
